algorithm.common_tail: length stored to +0x08, NUL byte stored at buffer + length, canary checked, destination returned
algorithm.length_computation: rdx - rsi at 0x5d4a6a2, stored to the stack slot
algorithm.long_path: length >= 16: _M_create PLT call at 0x5d4a715 with the length as the capacity variable and old capacity 0; returned pointer stored to +0x00, updated capacity stored to +0x10; memcpy at 0x5d4a729; previous +0x00 pointer replaced with no free call
algorithm.short_path: length <= 15: copy into the buffer named by +0x00; length 1 takes the single-byte copy at 0x5d4a6d7, other lengths take memcpy at 0x5d4a729, empty copies nothing; capacity untouched; no allocation or free

census.method: executable-LOAD-segment exhaustive E8/E9 scan with objdump confirmation, reproduced by census.py and re-run inside verify.py

consumers.caller_pattern: callers set the destination's +0x00 pointer to the object's own inline buffer (destination + 0x10) before calling, i.e. fresh small-string objects; each caller fills several string fields of one fresh object from source ranges

object_layout.plus_0x00: data pointer (read as the writable buffer; replaced on the long path)
object_layout.plus_0x08: size in bytes (set to the range length on every path)
object_layout.plus_0x10: capacity (set only on the long path, to the _M_create result; untouched on the short path)

arguments.rdx: range end (exclusive); length is rdx - rsi

unknowns: The exact capacity _M_create chooses on the long path is not pinned by this routine's excerpt; only that it is at least the length.
The libstdc++ name of this routine (a string range-fill step) is inference from its shape and its callers, not a pinned symbol; the pinned facts are the disassembly behavior and the call sites.

Whether any caller reuses a non-fresh destination on the short path is not established by the census; the short path assumes a buffer of at least length + 1 bytes at +0x00, as the observed fresh-object callers provide.
